programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: More efficiency, less weight and more sportiness is what Audi promotes in order to win the race against BMW and Mercedes with their A6 2.0 TDI. Also: Patrick Dempsey and his racing team at the Grand Am Rolex Sportscar GT series.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The emphatically sporty cars and motorbikes of BMW are equally successful with customers and in racing. However, the former aircraft engine manufacturer's entry into automobile production threatened to fail at an early stage.

programme.title: Car History

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Racing has been a matter of the heart for Ford for over 100 years. Henry Ford already wins the first race with his first car. Thousands of other victories were to follow.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The development of engineering at BMW has always been closely linked to motorsport. Racing has always played a decisive role in shaping the brand and setting the pace for its future.

programme.title: Car History

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16

programme.title: Supercars

programme.desc: Porsche is like a religion! The faiths: Punk, technology and racing. Porsche punk Magnus Walker preaches individualism for historic vehicles. Technology has been embodied by Alois RUF since 1983. And for the racers, there is the GT3 RS.

programme.desc: BMW tries to combine the electric future with fuel-saving features in the i8. In addition: the 'Race Chip' is tested on a 3,000-kilometre route. And: What is the benefit of the switchable performance enhancement from DTE Systems?

programme.desc: They are the US car icons par excellence: Chevy, Ford Mustang and Corvette. At Race 61, fans of historic racers pay homage to their heroes. And: we explore the history of the Ford Mustang up to the current model.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "JERSEY & ITALY"
programme.desc: Nestled some 12 miles off Normandy France lays the beautiful channel Island of Jersey. Part two we fly across to Portofino in Italy.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S7 - "Living & Golf"
programme.desc: Rick is looking for an investment property in either Canada or abroad. Real Estate Agent Tav Schembri shows Rick an incredible opportunity in Caledon while Real Estate Agent Mike Donia shows Rick an equally incredible opportunity in Panama.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S7 - "Spark Investment"

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S7 - "Pearl Island"
programme.desc: Tech entrepreneurs Paul and Jane are looking for an extreme luxury property with a lot of privacy. Broker Tav finds the couple an extraordinary property in Niagara-on-the-Lake while agent Mike Donia finds them their own paradise on Pearl Island.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Dordogne"
programme.desc: A family rushes to open a bar while awaiting bank approval. New B&B owners in the Dordogne welcome their first guests. A novice fisherman takes on his first trip in Spain.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Cape Verde"
programme.desc: An expat fisherman scores a big catch in Cape Verde, while another struggles in Spain. A French B&B receives its first review, and a boutique hotel launches a wedding business.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Boutique Wedding"
programme.desc: Steve and his mother-in-law serve food at their Spanish bar. Ray and Yvonne host a wedding at their hotel. Two ex-actors try to bring drama to Bordeaux amid a new baby\u2019s arrival.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Coolest Places to Hike, Stargaze, and See Natural Landmarks"
programme.desc: Strap on your boots to hike the world's longest trails, from the icy tundra of Norway to dry deserts, all to find the perfect spot for stargazing.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Northern Europe: From Iceland to Norway"
programme.desc: Head to colder climes to cross frosty Icelandic fjords, learn the history of mighty Vikings in Norway, and explore the icy expanse of Greenland.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The Magic of Eastern and Central Canada"
programme.desc: See the \"Great White North\" via skis and snowmobiles, trekking through the majestic winter landscapes and vibrant regions of Ontario and Quebec.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Race for the Place"
programme.desc: Will Bonnie and Matt\u2019s dreams of prefab living come true or will it all come crashing down? And in Hamilton, animal lovers Monique and Chris need to find their first home in a hurry\u2026.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S2 - "Balinese kitchen"
programme.desc: David gets busy in a Balinese kitchen and Alana meets a giant Chinese local.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S2 - "Shanghai"
programme.desc: Alana crashes into Shanghai and Scotty has a whale of a time in Hervey Bay.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S2 - "Maitland"
programme.desc: Alana stumbles upon the secret of eternal youth and Scotty goes under lock and key in Maitland.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Kerala"
programme.desc: Join us as we cruise the backwaters of Kerala, one of the most beautiful and serene areas of India. We explore the cities of Cochin and Kozhikode. Attend a local theatre performance and learn about traditional drama styles.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "The Far North: Amritsar, Shimla and Manali"
programme.desc: The Golden Temple is the centerpiece of the city of Amritsar, and probably the second most photographed building in India, but few know about the building or the people who built it.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Agra and Its Environs"
programme.desc: Agra is home to India\u2019s most recognizable monument\u2014the Taj Mahal. We tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal\u2019s construction.

programme.title: Beyond Borders
programme.desc: Discover unknown corners of the world in our new show 'Beyond Borders'! Join our dynamic duo for an unforgettable journey filled with adventures, culture, and breathtaking views.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S7 - "Mexican Heaven"
programme.desc: Brother and sister Mark and Beth are interested in purchasing a property that yields financial returns for their retirement. Our real estate agents Mike & Tav team up once again to find unique opportunities for residential investments.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S7 - "Hotel Vie"
programme.desc: In a very special episode of Top Million Dollar Agent, Laura Compagni teams up with Mataj Architects and The Parentela Family to introduce the first of the Hotel Vie chain of luxury hotels.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Madeira"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to Madeira for winter sun, whale watching, forest hikes, iconic basket rides, and a deep dive into local food and wine.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Beijing and beyond"
programme.desc: Ash has made it to Beijing, where he\u2019s meeting Terry Townsend to learn more about wildlife conservation in the region around the Great Wall of China. He also meets two more Wall Protectors and samples local delicacies in Shi Xia Village.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Eagle's Neck"
programme.desc: In his toughest challenge so far, Ash takes on Eagle\u2019s Neck \u2013 a notoriously steep and dangerous section of the Great Wall of China. But first, he meets tech experts who\u2019ve been helping to digitally map The Great Wall in an effort to protect it.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Inner Mongolia"
programme.desc: Following the Great Wall west, Ash heads to Inner Mongolia to meet up with a nomadic family and to try Mongolian wrestling. He\u2019s hoping to visit Naadam Festival, which features a key part of Mongolian culture: horseracing.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweet After Bitter"
programme.desc: From Teochew sweetrice cakes in China, sugarcane in India, to chocolate in Ivory Coast, this episode tells the story of how humans pursue and obtain sweetness, and how sweetness provides comfort and warmth to humanity.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Fez, Morocco"
programme.desc: In Fez, Morocco, not much has changed since the Middle Ages but Rodney is determined to stir things up and find tantalizing new dishes he can bring home.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Sardinia"
programme.desc: Rodney is in Sardinia, Italy, where he finds culinary inspiration around every corner. High in the Sardinian hills, his hosts prepare their specialty - roasted suckling pig. After sitting down to an outdoor family meal (where even the dog helps himself!), Rodney samples a myrtle-flavored liquor before dancing with his gentlemen hosts.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "India: Secrets of the Deep South"
programme.desc: Venture off the beaten path into southern India as Jonathan investigates the origins of mysterious temples and untold regional histories.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "India: Chasing the Ramayana"
programme.desc: Riding a Royal Enfield, Jonathan retraces the epic Ramayana through crocodile habitats and sunken temples to the edge of the subcontinent.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat the World S1 - "Flamenco to Portugal"
programme.desc: After attempting flamenco dancing, the lads cross into Portugal, cooking with top chef Jos\u00E9 Avillez before catching fresh snapper in the Algarve.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "The Unforgettable Journey"
programme.desc: Jess explores the ancient towns and iconic landmarks of Rajasthan. The crew continues to Jaipur, uncovering more cultural treasures and reunites with Pulak for the final stretch to Delhi. After a few bike troubles, Jess and her team arrive in Delhi, reflecting on the unforgettable journey they've shared together.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Kapiti"
programme.desc: On the Kapiti Coast, Piri and keen fisherman, Jason Huria, target snapper and tarakihi. Piri jumps on a twin hulled waka with Te Wera Henare to sail out to Kapiti island.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Tūranga-nui-a-Kiwa"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Crusader Tu Umaga-Marshall are in T\u016Branga-nui-a-Kiwa (Gisborne), diving for Haku (Kingfish), boxing with the Patu Tahi Boxing Club and meeting Gisborne\u2019s local horse whisperer Sam Sidney.

programme.title: Running the World S1 - "Delhi"
programme.desc: Parkour athletes Max & Benj Cave head to Delhi India to complete a treacherous final run challenge.

programme.title: Running the World S1 - "Mexico City"
programme.desc: Brothers Max & Benj Cave race through an 18th century monastery on the outskirts of Mexico City and whoever rings the bell in the tower first wins.

programme.title: Running the World S1 - "Gran Canaria"
programme.desc: Brothers Max & Benj Cave are challenged to create a run through an abandoned water park on the island of Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Stunning Scenario"
programme.desc: A day of gruelling grape picking lies ahead and the duo discover a new love for the country\u2019s greatest export.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Back to where it all started"
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave are reaching the end of their incredible journey and must go back to where it all started Buenos Aires.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "6000 km"
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave make a toast to their recently finished trip rough riding across Argentina.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Yerevan"
programme.desc: Josh goes local exploring in Armenia and its capital Yerevan, visiting some amazing abandoned Soviet buildings, a knitting factory and a luxurious hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Gary, Indiana"
programme.desc: Josh is back in Gary, Indiana, for a local exploring adventure. With friends, he visits a former bank, the memorial auditorium and Union Train Station.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Zagreb"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring: Going Local visits Zagreb, Croatia. Cody fires a canon from the old tower, explores a never finished University Hospital and a political school.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 7"
programme.desc: After a week, Kevin and Jalou find themselves in the same country again: Canada. They travel from Vancouver to Whistler for the final challenge.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Sri Lanka: Legends of Ceylon"
programme.desc: Jonathan tracks ancient myths across Sri Lanka, unearthing sobering tsunami stories, hidden lighthouses, and unique local beverages.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Sri Lanka: Footsteps of Ravana"
programme.desc: Jonathan hunts for mythological sites with local monks before embedding with the Vedda people, the island's original indigenous inhabitants.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Taiwan: Bunkers and Bubble Tea"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores urban farms, decodes bubble tea origins, and hunts for the truth behind Taiwan's vast network of hidden military bunkers.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Brazil’s Pantanal"
programme.desc: There may be no place on earth so rich in wildlife as Brazil\u2019s Pantanal. In this Quest, Bill is going to track some of the rainforest creatures he\u2019s always wanted to see.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Cultural Rwanda"
programme.desc: They say time heals all wounds, but can it heal the most horrific of all\u2014genocide. On this Quest, Bill returns to Rwanda to see the post-war healing happening in this small, but globally significant country.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Australia Top to Bottom"
programme.desc: Australia is a giant country with diverse ecosystems that make it one of the most interesting in the world. This episode of Travel Quest explores the north and far south of this country\u2026the world\u2019s biggest \u201Cisland\u201D.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kushtia, Bangladesh"
programme.desc: The brothers traverse the country\u2019s interconnecting network of waterways by ferryboat. From shrimp baron, to peasant fishermen, lofty temple ruins to anonymous chai wallahs, they make their way to Kushtia, home to the shrine of Guru Lalone Shaw.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kingdom of Mustang, Nepal"
programme.desc: Securing special visas, the brothers get 10 ponies and 6 porters and undertake a stunning, but difficult 13-day pony trek over the Himalayas to the valley of Mustang where they will try to have a sitting with the king.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Iceberg Alley, Newfoundland, Canada"
programme.desc: Flying a bush plane to the far-reaching tip of the \u2018Rock\u2019, the brothers are back in the rugged, isolated island where they were born. Via kayak, the brothers paddle from fishing port to fishing port before reaching their ultimate destination.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Te Urewera"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Warrior Wairangi Koopu are deep in Te Urewera. Hosted by Waimana\u2019s local all female hunting group the \u201CWahine Slayaz\u201D, they hunt Deer, gather Oysters and make Rongo\u0101 with Koro Hori Hillman.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Taupō"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Crusader Tu Umaga-Marshall are in Taup\u014D, on the lake targeting Trout, having a run around with the Taup\u014D Juniors Touch Team and learning some Taup\u014D H\u012Btori from Piri\u2019s high school mate Awhina Eru.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Whakatū"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Warrior Wairangi Koopu are down in Whakat\u016B (Nelson). They\u2019re hosted by Cyril Collier targeting Snapper, put to the test by Raniera Petersen with a Mau Rakau lesson and visit the Anatoki Salmon Farm.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Hawaii"
programme.desc: Chris travels to Hawaii\u2019s Big Island, hikes to the heart of a volcano and takes a night dive that brings him face to face with dozens of giant manta rays.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Kangaroo Island"
programme.desc: Chris takes a photo challenge on beautiful Kangaroo Island and finds himself swimming in some unusual company.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Wildest Swimming"
